name: binance-klines
note: Hourly candles for the pair in the URL: [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, ...].

name: ths-klines
note: Daily candles as a compact string: date,open,high,low,close,volume,amount per row. The hs_ prefix covers Shanghai and Shenzhen; other boards need their own adapter entry.

name: tradingview-symbol
note: TradingView streams its candles over an in-page WebSocket, so no HTTP request can fetch them. Without a `request` this adapter reports the charted symbol only; route it to a data source you can query (for example the binance adapter's endpoint) if you need the series.
